phase_note: G5 spatial hierarchy only. Population headcount, prices, parcel counts, pavement, and meshes stay later. physicalize stays false.
title: Settlement layout grammar: districts and internal roads on named W06 regions. Not an NPC sprinkle and not a mesh pass.
pipeline_note: This slice authors the slots Pop, Economy, Growth, and Infra write into. It does not run those stages. Mesh physicalization is G6.
algorithm: Copy W06 region_id, world_id, tier, cannot_found, stamp_cells, parent_region_id. Do not rescore.
If cannot_found and the region is not hub_doors, emit no layout.
Fold hub_doors into layout_hub_court as dist_hub_doors. Do not emit a second Hub city.
If stamp_cells is false and cannot_found is false, emit a role sketch with coordinates null and roads empty.
Assign uses from the closed seven. Stop at the tier cap.
Agricultural use only where a W07 farm site exists. That is farm_masond_landings only.
Water use only for a named walkable body that is already a river, lock, harbor march, or working river. Civic drain, ice, drowned founding, the 24 km strait, and the Dawn shore do not qualify.
Industrial mine yards only where a W07 mine exists. Salvage, lattice works, and the Sere shift are industrial without a new mine.
A spine or wharf cites an existing W05 id. It does not add an edge and it does not set finished.
Class unfinished stays paved false. seam_crucible_cyber stays finished false.
controlled_districts absent from unity_district_id fields stay in not_layout. They are claim-plane names.
Leave population and parcel_count null. Leave physicalize false.

outputs_for_later_stages.population: May attach a headcount to an existing district_id. May not add a district. May not read populationBaseline or a claim radius. Sere role sketches take no kilometre census.
outputs_for_later_stages.economy: May price a district that cites a W07 site_id, plus dist_hub_market as import food with no local yield. May not open a market on port_sere_pier. May not price breadlands.
outputs_for_later_stages.growth: May set parcel_count only after a headcount exists. This file leaves parcel_count null. Growth may not spend headcount on a new use.
outputs_for_later_stages.infrastructure: May pave a road only when its cites_edge is finished, or when class is ring, lane, terrace, wharf, or built_relief. Class unfinished stays unpaved. No new edge ids.
outputs_for_later_stages.g6_mesh: May mesh a district only after a later stage sets physicalize true. TreeLayer does not scatter the plaza and does not clearcut Nil.
